description: audit.sh is valid bash (no syntax errors)
what: audit.sh contains a bash syntax error
why: A broken audit.sh makes the entire verification pipeline fail silently — the repo self-audit stops working
fix: Run 'bash -n audit.sh' locally and fix the reported syntax error on the indicated line

description: verify-feature.sh is valid bash (no syntax errors)
what: scripts/verify-feature.sh contains a bash syntax error
why: A broken verify-feature.sh disables the pass-state gate — features cannot be transitioned to passing
fix: Run 'bash -n scripts/verify-feature.sh' locally and fix the reported syntax error

description: check-arch.sh is valid bash (no syntax errors)
what: scripts/check-arch.sh contains a bash syntax error
why: A broken check-arch.sh means architectural constraints are not enforced
fix: Run 'bash -n scripts/check-arch.sh' locally and fix the reported syntax error

what: feature_list.json contains a JSON syntax error
why: Invalid JSON breaks make vcr, verify-feature.sh, and audit.sh — the entire harness state-tracking pipeline fails
fix: Run 'jq . feature_list.json' to see the parse error, then fix the malformed JSON at the reported line

description: No placeholder '@exit 1' commands in root Makefile targets
what: Found '@exit 1' placeholder in root Makefile — a target is not yet implemented
why: Placeholder targets cause 'make check' to fail with a misleading error and break self-audit
fix: Replace '@exit 1' with the actual command for that target, or remove the target if it does not apply to this repo
